theory.title: Segundo condicional para situaciones hipotéticas
theory.explanation: Usa if + pasado simple junto con would + infinitivo para hablar de situaciones imaginarias o poco probables. Could y might expresan posibles resultados. If I were you (si yo fuera tú) es una fórmula habitual para dar consejos.
theory.tip: If + pasado simple, would + infinitivo. Aunque usamos pasado, hablamos de una situación hipotética presente o futura.

content.passage: Two flatmates disagreed about noise in the evenings. If Alex lowered the music, Priya would be able to study. Alex said he would do that if Priya told him when she needed quiet. If they took turns choosing the music, both of them might feel included. Priya added that if she were Alex, she would use headphones after ten. They decided to write a simple timetable. The solution was not perfect, but if they communicated more openly, they would avoid the same argument next week.
